AUTOSAR Classic System Services

Die System Services steuern den gesamten ECU-Lebenszyklus von Power-On über Wakeup, Betriebszustände, Modus-Arbitrierung (BswM) bis zum sicheren Herunterfahren und Programmlauf-Überwachung (WdgM).

Systemarchitektur & Rolle des Modulclusters

Das Modulcluster System Services bildet das funktionale Rückgrat der AUTOSAR Classic Platform im Release R20-11. Es koordiniert das Zustands- und Modusmanagement des Gesamtsystems sowie die Überwachung der Softwareausführung und der Hardware-Watchdogs. Innerhalb der AUTOSAR-Schichtenarchitektur sind die Module EcuM (ECU State Manager), BswM (Basic Software Mode Manager) und WdgM (Watchdog Manager) in den BSW-Systemdiensten angesiedelt, während das Modul Wdg (Watchdog Driver) als Treiberkomponente der Microcontroller Abstraction Layer (MCAL) die direkte Schnittstelle zur Watchdog-Hardware realisiert [SWS_Wdg_00055], [SWS_Wdg_00161].

Der ECU State Manager (EcuM) übernimmt primär die Kontrolle über die Initialisierungsphase vor dem Betriebssystemstart (StartPreOS) sowie die Beendigung und Schlafübergänge des Steuergeräts [SWS_EcuM_02411], [SWS_EcuM_03022]. Er verwaltet die sequenzielle Abarbeitung der Treiberinitialisierungsblöcke init block 0 und init block 1 und initialisiert fundamentale Basistreiber, bevor das Betriebssystem gestartet wird [SWS_EcuM_02559], [SWS_EcuM_02603]. Zudem erfasst und validiert EcuM Weckereignisse über konfigurierbare Protokolle und steuert den Eintritt in den Halt- oder Poll-Modus bei Schlafzuständen [SWS_EcuM_02479], [SWS_EcuM_02960], [SWS_EcuM_02962].

Der BSW Mode Manager (BswM) fungiert als zentrale Instanz für die Modusarbitrierung des gesamten Steuergeräts [SWS_BswM_00035]. Er aggregiert Modusanforderungen und Zustandsindikationen von Software-Komponenten (SW-Cs) über RTE-Ports sowie von BSW-Modulen, darunter Kommunikationsmanager (ComM), Bus-State-Manager (CanSM, LinSM, FrSM, EthSM) und Diagnosemodule (Dcm) [SWS_BswM_00046], [SWS_BswM_00047], [SWS_BswM_00048], [SWS_BswM_00049], [SWS_BswM_00201]. Auf Basis konfigurierter logischer Regeln führt BswM Aktionen in vordefinierten Aktionslisten aus, um Zielzustände im System konsistent zu steuern [SWS_BswM_00147].

Die Betriebssicherheit wird durch das Tandem aus Watchdog Manager (WdgM) und Watchdog Driver (Wdg) gewährleistet. WdgM überwacht die funktionale Integrität von Applikationen und BSW-Modulen anhand von Kontrollpunkten über Alive-Supervision, Deadline-Supervision und logische Kontrollflussüberwachung [SWS_WdgM_00146], [SWS_WdgM_00263], [SWS_WdgM_00373]. WdgM steuert wiederum die Betriebsmodi und Triggerbedingungen der Watchdog-Treiberinstanzen [SWS_WdgM_00186]. Wdg bedient die eigentliche Hardware (intern oder extern) und setzt die von WdgM definierten Trigger-Bedingungen zyklisch um [SWS_Wdg_00001], [SWS_Wdg_00134], [SWS_Wdg_00144].

Architekturdiagramm: Statische Struktur und Schnittstellenbeziehungen im Cluster System Services. Quellen: [SWS_EcuM_02858], [SWS_WdgM_00162], [SWS_Wdg_00144].

Zusammenspiel & Interaktionspfade zwischen den Modulen

Das Zusammenspiel der Clusterkomponenten basiert auf wohldefinierten Kontroll- und Meldeketten. Während der Startphase initialisiert EcuM über BswM_Init sämtliche kernlokalen Instanzen des BSW Mode Managers [SWS_EcuM_04014], [SWS_BswM_00002]. Im weiteren Betriebsablauf meldet EcuM Statusänderungen von Weckquellen über die Schnittstelle BswM_EcuM_CurrentWakeup an BswM [SWS_EcuM_04079], [SWS_BswM_00131]. Ebenso leitet EcuM Anforderungen bezüglich des RUN-Zustands über BswM_EcuM_RequestedState weiter und rapportiert seinen aktuellen Zustand über BswM_EcuM_CurrentState [SWS_EcuM_04117], [SWS_EcuM_04143], [SWS_BswM_91003], [SWS_BswM_91004].

Nach Auswertung der internen Arbitrierungsregeln instruiert BswM seinerseits den EcuM mittels des synchronen Aufrufs EcuM_SetState, um Phasenwechsel (wie STARTUP, RUN, POST_RUN, SLEEP oder SHUTDOWN) zu vollziehen [SWS_EcuM_04116], [SWS_EcuM_04122], [SWS_EcuM_04132]. Parallel dazu steuert BswM den Betriebsmodus des Watchdog Managers über WdgM_SetMode, womit Überwachungsprofile an den aktuellen Steuergerätebetrieb angepasst werden [SWS_WdgM_00154], [SWS_WdgM_00182], [SWS_WdgM_00315].

Der Interaktionspfad zwischen Überwachung und Fehlerreaktion verbindet WdgM mit BswM und EcuM: Erkennt WdgM das Scheitern einer überwachten Einheit (Supervised Entity), kann er bei BSW-Partitionsfehlern über BswM_WdgM_RequestPartitionReset einen gezielten Partitionsneustart beim BSW Mode Manager anfordern [SWS_WdgM_00162], [SWS_BswM_00157]. Führt eine Fehlfunktion zum globalen Überwachungsstatus WDGM_GLOBAL_STATUS_STOPPED, löst WdgM via WdgM_PerformReset einen Reset aus oder stellt das Bedienen der Watchdogs ein [SWS_WdgM_00264], [SWS_WdgM_00375]. Ein solcher Watchdog-Vorfall wird von EcuM als Abschalt- und Reset-Ursache ECUM_CAUSE_WDGM erfasst [SWS_EcuM_04007], [SWS_EcuM_04045].

Zwischen WdgM und Wdg erfolgt die Ansteuerung primär über die Festlegung der Betriebsart und das Setzen von Triggerbedingungen: WdgM konfiguriert den Treibermodus über Wdg_SetMode und übergibt die erlaubte Zeitspanne mittels Wdg_SetTriggerCondition [SWS_WdgM_00186], [SWS_Wdg_00107], [SWS_Wdg_00155]. Der Watchdog-Treiber rechnet den übergebenen Millisekundenwert in hardwarebezogene Zählerstände um [SWS_Wdg_00138]. Läuft die Überwachung fehlerfrei, dekrementiert die periodische Servicing-Routine den Zähler und bedient die Hardware; läuft die Triggerbedingung ab oder wird sie explizit auf null gesetzt, unterbleibt die Bedienung und die Hardware erzwingt den Reset [SWS_Wdg_00134], [SWS_Wdg_00135], [SWS_Wdg_00140].

Sequenzdiagramm: Interaktionspfad von Modusanforderung und Arbitrierung bis zum Watchdog-Servicing. Quellen: [SWS_EcuM_04014], [SWS_EcuM_04144], [SWS_BswM_00035], [SWS_WdgM_00186], [SWS_Wdg_00155].

Synchronisation, Reentranz und Task-Kontexte

Die System Services weisen aufgrund ihrer Architektur unterschiedliche Ausführungskontexte auf, die von interruptgetriebenen Weckpfaden bis zu zyklischen Scheduling-Tasks reichen. Elementare Weckdienste von EcuM, namentlich EcuM_SetWakeupEvent, EcuM_GetPendingWakeupEvents und EcuM_ClearWakeupEvent, sind synchron, nicht-unterbrechbar und explizit dafür ausgelegt, aus ISR-Kontexten, OS-Task-Kontexten sowie in OS-freien Umgebungen aufgerufen zu werden [SWS_EcuM_02171], [SWS_EcuM_02172], [SWS_EcuM_02807], [SWS_EcuM_02826]. Die Weckvalidierung EcuM_ValidateWakeupEvent ist ebenfalls aus Interrupt- und Task-Ebene aufrufbar und als reentrant spezifiziert [SWS_EcuM_02345], [SWS_EcuM_02829].

Im laufenden Betrieb werden asynchrone und verzögerte Aufgaben über die zyklischen MainFunctions der Module abgewickelt. Die EcuM_MainFunction führt die Weckvalidierungs-Timeouts fort, aktualisiert den systemweiten Alarm-Clock-Dienst und läuft instanzspezifisch auf allen Kernen [SWS_EcuM_02539], [SWS_EcuM_02837], [SWS_EcuM_04002], [SWS_EcuM_04011]. In BswM evaluiert die BswM_MainFunction sämtliche Regeln, deren Eingangsmodusanforderungen als BSWM_DEFERRED konfiguriert sind, und verarbeitet Timer-Arbitrierungen [SWS_BswM_00053], [SWS_BswM_00075], [SWS_BswM_00220]. Die WdgM_MainFunction berechnet den globalen Überwachungsstatus aus den lokalen Zuständen, überwacht Deadline-Timeouts und aktualisiert die Watchdog-Triggerung [SWS_WdgM_00159], [SWS_WdgM_00404], [SWS_WdgM_00406].

Zur Synchronisation auf Multicore-Steuergeräten reserviert EcuM für jeden Kern während der Phase GoSleep eine dedizierte OS-Ressource (RES_AUTOSAR_ECUM) [SWS_EcuM_03010]. Das Anfahren und Stoppen der Kerne erfolgt in koordinierter Folge zwischen Master- und Slave-Kernen [SWS_EcuM_04015], [SWS_EcuM_04017], [SWS_EcuM_04027]. Auf Treiberebene erfordern Moduswechsel oder das Servicing im Modul Wdg bei Bedarf das Deaktivieren von Interrupts zum Schutz kritischer Hardwareregister [SWS_Wdg_00040]. Um konkurrierende Zugriffe abzufangen, wird der interne Zustand des Watchdog-Treibers während laufender Operationen auf WDG_BUSY gesetzt [SWS_Wdg_00018], [SWS_Wdg_00052].

Typische Lebenszyklen und Betriebsmodi

Der Lebenszyklus des Systems gliedert sich in deterministische Phasen: STARTUP, RUN, POST_RUN, SLEEP und SHUTDOWN [SWS_EcuM_04107], [SWS_EcuM_04132]. In der STARTUP-Phase beginnt EcuM_Init mit der StartPreOS Sequence [SWS_EcuM_02411], [SWS_EcuM_02811]. Hierbei wird vor Initialisierung des ersten BSW-Moduls die Konsistenz der Konfigurationsdaten über den Hashwert ECUM_CONFIGCONSISTENCY_HASH geprüft [SWS_EcuM_02795], [SWS_EcuM_02796], [SWS_EcuM_02798]. Nach Ausführung hardwarenaher Callouts (EcuM_AL_DriverInitZero, EcuM_AL_DriverInitOne) und der Weckursachenbestimmung startet EcuM SchM und OS auf jedem Kern [SWS_EcuM_02601], [SWS_EcuM_02905], [SWS_EcuM_02907], [SWS_EcuM_04093], [SWS_EcuM_04145]. Direkt im Anschluss an StartOS ruft ein Autostart-Task EcuM_StartupTwo auf, um die BSW-Initialisierungslisten abzuarbeiten und BswM_Init sowie WdgM_Init anzustoßen [SWS_EcuM_02806], [SWS_EcuM_02838], [SWS_EcuM_02932], [SWS_EcuM_04014], [SWS_WdgM_00151].

Im Betrieb fordern Applikations-SW-Cs über EcuM_RequestRUN oder EcuM_RequestPOST_RUN die Aktivhaltung der ECU an [SWS_EcuM_04124], [SWS_EcuM_04128]. EcuM verwaltet diese Anforderungen userspezifisch und meldet Statuswechsel über BswM_EcuM_RequestedState an BswM [SWS_EcuM_04126], [SWS_EcuM_04144]. Werden alle Anforderungen über EcuM_ReleaseRUN bzw. EcuM_ReleasePOST_RUN freigegeben, meldet EcuM den Status ECUM_RUNSTATUS_RELEASED an BswM [SWS_EcuM_04117], [SWS_EcuM_04119], [SWS_EcuM_04127], [SWS_EcuM_04129]. BswM entscheidet daraufhin über die Einleitung von Schlaf- oder Abschaltsequenzen [SWS_BswM_00035].

Für den Schlafzustand wählt das System mittels EcuM_SelectShutdownTarget das Ziel ECUM_SHUTDOWN_TARGET_SLEEP nebst konfiguriertem Schlafmodus [SWS_EcuM_00624], [SWS_EcuM_02185], [SWS_EcuM_02822]. EcuM schärft die Weckquellen via EcuM_EnableWakeupSources [SWS_EcuM_02389], [SWS_EcuM_02918]. Vor dem Eintritt in den Halt-Modus wird die RAM-Integrität über EcuM_GenerateRamHash abgesichert [SWS_EcuM_02863], [SWS_EcuM_02960]. Im Poll-Modus führt EcuM eine blockierende Schleife mit EcuM_SleepActivity und EcuM_CheckWakeup aus [SWS_EcuM_02928], [SWS_EcuM_02929], [SWS_EcuM_03020]. Tritt ein Weckereignis auf, durchläuft das Steuergerät die WakeupRestart-Sequenz: EcuM_AL_DriverRestart reinitialisiert Wecktreiber, EcuM_CheckRamHash prüft den Speicher und das Validierungsprotokoll verifiziert das Weckereignis [SWS_EcuM_02562], [SWS_EcuM_02921], [SWS_EcuM_02923], [SWS_EcuM_02963].

Beim Herunterfahren zu ECUM_SHUTDOWN_TARGET_OFF oder ECUM_SHUTDOWN_TARGET_RESET werden BSW-Module ordnungsgemäß deinitialisiert [SWS_EcuM_03022], [SWS_EcuM_04136]. WdgM_DeInit beendet Überwachungsfunktionen [SWS_WdgM_00261], [SWS_WdgM_00407], und BswM_Deinit sperrt die Modusverarbeitung [SWS_BswM_00119], [SWS_BswM_00120]. Zuletzt ruft EcuM die Funktion ShutdownOS auf, woraufhin der ShutdownHook die Ausführung an EcuM_Shutdown übergibt, was über EcuM_AL_SwitchOff das Abschalten oder über EcuM_AL_Reset den Neustart auslöst [SWS_EcuM_02812], [SWS_EcuM_02952], [SWS_EcuM_02953], [SWS_EcuM_04074], [SWS_EcuM_04075].

Fehlerbehandlung, Det-Tracing und Degradation

Die Fehlererkennung im Cluster unterscheidet zwischen Entwicklungsfehlern (Det), Laufzeitfehlern und produktionsrelevanten Diagnoseereignissen (Dem). Bei aktivierter Entwicklungserkennung (DevErrorDetect) prüfen alle Module vor Funktionsausführung ihren Initialisierungszustand: Vorzeitige Aufrufe werden mit BSWM_E_UNINIT (0x01) [SWS_BswM_00078], [SWS_BswM_00230], ECUM_E_UNINIT [SWS_EcuM_03009], WDGM_E_UNINIT (0x10) [SWS_WdgM_00004], [SWS_WdgM_00173] bzw. WDG_E_DRIVER_STATE (0x10) [SWS_Wdg_00010] an Det gemeldet. Zudem werden ungültige Parametergrenzen, wie unzulässige Modusanforderungen in BswM [SWS_BswM_00091], unbekannte Weckquellen in EcuM [SWS_EcuM_02867] oder ein Überschreiten des maximalen Timeout-Werts WdgMaxTimeout in Wdg [SWS_Wdg_00146], strikt abgefangen.

Laufzeitfehler und Protokollverletzungen führen zu gezielten Rückmeldungen: Schlägt eine Aktion in BswM fehl, meldet das Modul BSWM_E_ACTION_FAILED [SWS_BswM_00238]. In EcuM führen unzulässige Mehrfachanforderungen oder unpassende Freigaben zu ECUM_E_MULTIPLE_RUN_REQUESTS bzw. ECUM_E_MISMATCHED_RUN_RELEASE [SWS_EcuM_03023], [SWS_EcuM_03024]. Schwerwiegende, nicht behebbare Zustände leitet EcuM an den Callout EcuM_ErrorHook weiter [SWS_EcuM_02904], [SWS_EcuM_04033], beispielsweise bei inkonsistenten Postbuild-Konfigurationsdaten (ECUM_E_CONFIGURATION_DATA_INCONSISTENT) oder bei gescheiterter RAM-Integritätsprüfung (ECUM_E_RAM_CHECK_FAILED) nach dem Aufwachen [SWS_EcuM_02987], [SWS_EcuM_91003].

Für Degradations- und Sicherheitskonzepte ist die Anbindung an Dem essenziell: Scheitert die Ablaufüberwachung im Watchdog Manager endgültig, setzt WdgM das Diagnoseereignis WDGM_E_SUPERVISION ab [SWS_WdgM_00162], [SWS_WdgM_00375]. Der Watchdog-Treiber meldet Fehlschläge bei Moduswechseln über WDG_E_MODE_FAILED sowie unzulässige Deaktivierungsversuche über WDG_E_DISABLE_REJECTED an Dem [SWS_Wdg_00111], [SWS_Wdg_00178], [SWS_Wdg_00179], [SWS_Wdg_00180], [SWS_Wdg_00182]. Tritt ein Überwachungsfehler auf, degradiert der lokale Status der betroffenen Einheit von WDGM_LOCAL_STATUS_OK über WDGM_LOCAL_STATUS_FAILED bis WDGM_LOCAL_STATUS_EXPIRED [SWS_WdgM_00359]. Um nach einem hierdurch ausgelösten Watchdog-Reset die Ursache identifizieren zu können, hinterlegt WdgM die Kennung der ersten abgelaufenen Einheit im nicht-initialisierten RAM als doppelt-inversen Wert, der vor WdgM_Init über WdgM_GetFirstExpiredSEID auslesbar ist und erst während der Reinitialisierung bereinigt wird [SWS_WdgM_00346], [SWS_WdgM_00348], [SWS_WdgM_00349], [SWS_WdgM_00370].

Dieser Leitfaden basiert ausschließlich auf den Spezifikationsanforderungen von AUTOSAR Classic Release R20-11 für das Cluster System Services.

Module im Cluster

ECU State Manager (EcuM)

Controls ECU lifecycle states: Startup, Run, PostRun, Sleep, and Shutdown.

BSW ID 10 65 APIs (52 Funktionen, 13 Typen) #include "EcuM.h"

BSW Mode Manager (BswM)

Arbitrates mode requests and executes action lists to control system state transitions.

BSW ID 42 35 APIs (32 Funktionen, 3 Typen) #include "BswM.h"

Watchdog Manager (WdgM)

Performs alive supervision, deadline supervision, and logical program flow monitoring.

BSW ID 13 19 APIs (11 Funktionen, 8 Typen) #include "WdgM.h"

Du bist der offizielle KI-Kurations-Assistent für das autodocs Dokumentations- und Spezifikationssystem (AUTOSAR & S-Core).
Deine Aufgabe ist es, präzise, fachlich fundierte Erklärungen, User Guides und Diagramme zu verfassen.

FOLGENDE RICHTLINIEN SIND STRIKT BINDEND:
# Richtlinien für KI-generierte Erklärungen

Diese Datei wird von den Prompt-Rezepten (`_src/tools/prompt_recipes.py`)
wörtlich in jeden Prompt eingebettet. Jede Änderung ändert daher alle
Prompt-Hashes; bestehende KI-Texte gelten dann als veraltet und werden neu
erzeugt. Herkunft und Ablage der Ausgaben regelt `_src/lib_ai_store.py`.

## Sprache

- Kanonische Sprache ist Deutsch. Die Übersetzung ist ein nachgelagerter Schritt
  und nie Teil der Generierung.
- API-Bezeichner, Typnamen, Enum-Werte, Code und Kennungen wie `[SWS_…]` bleiben
  unverändert.

## Struktur

- Jedes Fragment ist genau ein `<div class="ai …">` (Varianten: `ai usage` für
  Verwendungshinweise an einem Spezifikationselement, `ai module-guide` für
  Modul-Leitfäden) und endet mit genau einem `<p class="ai-note">` (KI-Hinweis).
- Erlaubte Elemente im Fragment: `div`, `p`, `h4`, `ul`, `ol`, `li`, `code`,
  `strong`, `em`, `a`, `span`, `table`, `thead`, `tbody`, `tr`, `th`, `td`.
  Keine Skripte, keine Stile, keine Bilder, kein `<svg>` (Diagramme siehe unten).
- Alle Tags korrekt geschlossen und verschachtelt.

## Belegpflicht

- Jede fachliche Aussage ist zu belegen. Belege stammen ausschließlich aus dem
  Payload des Prompts; nichts darf aus anderem Wissen als Beleg ausgegeben werden.
- Verweis auf ein Spezifikationselement oder Requirement (nur IDs, die im
  Payload vorkommen):
  `<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_…">[SWS_…]</a>` — ohne `href`; den
  Link setzt der Generator.
- Verweis auf eine Dokumentstelle (nur Dokument/Seite aus dem Payload):
  `<span class="docref" data-doc="<Dokument-ID>" data-page="<Seite>">Kurzname §x.y „Titel“</span>`.
- Niemals URLs ausgeben, insbesondere keine PDF-URLs.

## Annahmen (Wissenslücken)

- Wo die Quellen schweigen, sind höchstens 3 Annahmen je Text und 2 je
  Diagramm erlaubt.
- Jede Annahme ist im Text als Interpretation erkennbar („dürfte“, „vermutlich“,
  „Interpretation:“) und wird am Ende des Fragments in einem Kommentar
  `<!-- annahmen: 1) … – Begründung: … -->` aufgezählt.
- Reicht das Budget nicht, wird der Aspekt weggelassen — niemals unmarkiert
  spekulieren.

## Diagramme

Ein Diagramm nur, wenn es gegenüber dem Text Mehrwert bietet:

- Sequenzdiagramm: Abläufe ab 3 Schritten oder mit nicht offensichtlicher
  Reihenfolge/Asynchronität.
- Kontext-/Kollaborationsdiagramm: ab 3 beteiligten Komponenten.
- Zustandsdiagramm: Lebenszyklen und Zustandsmaschinen.
- Aktivitätsdiagramm: Entscheidungs- oder Verarbeitungsabläufe mit Verzweigung.
- Keine Trivialdiagramme (einzelne Aufrufe, Getter/Setter, Zweierbeziehungen).

Beschriftungen deutsch, Bezeichner unverändert. Jedes Diagramm steht im
Fragment als Platzhalter `<div class="diagram" id="diag-<kurzname>"></div>`,
direkt gefolgt von `<p class="diagram-note"><Diagrammart>: <Kernaussage>.
Quellen: <Belege></p>`. Die Diagrammquelle wird separat ausgegeben (Format
legt der Prompt fest).

KONTEXT-SYNTHESE- & EVIDENZ-REGELN (CONCEPT-0056):
1. KONTINUIERLICHE SYNTHESE: Alle übergebenen Inbound-Snippets fließen ohne Kurationspause ein.
2. ZWEISTUFIGE EVIDENZ-KENNZEICHNUNG:
   - VERIFIED (Score >= 0.95): Normativ verbindliche Belege, faktischer Text, Badge <span class="badge-pill bp-curated">🔒 Verifizierter Kontext</span>.
   - UNVERIFIED (0.70 <= Score < 0.95): Zwingend mit folgender Warnbox formatieren:
     <div class="ai-unverified-evidence" data-snippet-id="{ID}" data-confidence="{SCORE}">
       <div class="ai-unverified-header">
         <span class="badge-pill bp-ai">⚠️ UNVERIFIED AI HYPOTHESIS &bull; Konfidenz: {SCORE}</span>
         <span class="ai-unverified-actions">
           <a href="spec/record.html?id={REC_ID}#curate-{ID}" class="btn-curate-inline dossier-open-link" data-dossier-target="dossier-modal-{REC_ID}" data-snippet-id="{ID}">🔍 Im Curation-Editor prüfen &rarr;</a>
         </span>
       </div>
       <p class="ai-unverified-body">
         <strong>UNVERIFIED AI HYPOTHESIS (Nicht ohne formale Kuration für Serienentwicklung verwenden):</strong><br>
         <em>Interpretation / Vorläufiger Kontext:</em> [Interpretation der Anforderung]
       </p>
     </div>
3. DUKTUS FÜR UNVERIFIED HYPOTHESEN: Als abgeleitete Vermutung formulieren ('dürfte', 'lässt sich ableiten', 'Interpretation:'), niemals als verbindlicher Normentext.
4. TOKEN-BUDGET: Bis zu 90% des Kontextfensters können genutzt werden. Output ist limitiert auf max 8192 Tokens.
5. TRIVIALITÄTS-FILTER (INV-TRIVIALITY-WHITELIST-04): Enums, Typen und Methoden mit State-Machine-, Lifecycle-, E2E- oder Concurrency-Bezug sind niemals trivial.

AUTOSAR_SWS_OS ([SWS_Os_00676]) · 📄 PDF · ↗ Im Modul Os
Konstituierend · function
void StartCore (CoreIdType Core ID, StatusType* Status);

It is not supported to call this function after Start OS(). The function starts the core specified by the parameter Core ID. The OUT parameter allows the caller to check whether the operation was successful or no t. If a core is started by means of this function Start OS shall be called on the core.

AUTOSAR_SWS_OS ([SWS_Os_00682]) · 📄 PDF · ↗ Im Modul Os
Konstituierend · function
void Start Non Autosar Core (CoreIdType Core ID, StatusType* Status);

The function start s the core specified by the parameter Core ID. It is allowed to call this function after Start OS(). The OUT parameter allows the caller to check whether the operation was successful or not. It is not allowed to call Start OS on cores activated by Start No n Autosar Core. Otherwise the behaviour is unspecified.

▸ GetSpinlock [SWS_Os_00686] Os function AUTOSAR_SWS_OS
Unbewertet
AUTOSAR_SWS_OS ([SWS_Os_00686]) · 📄 PDF · ↗ Im Modul Os
Konstituierend · function
StatusType GetSpinlock (SpinlockIdType SpinlockId);

Get Spinlock tries to occupy a spin - lock variable. If the function returns, either the lock is successfully taken or an error has occurred. The spinlock mechanism is an active polling mechanism. The function does not cause a de - scheduling.

Eigenschaft: Konstituierende Modul-SpezifikationRecord-ID: SWS_Os_00686
▸ ReleaseSpinlock [SWS_Os_00695] Os function AUTOSAR_SWS_OS
Unbewertet
AUTOSAR_SWS_OS ([SWS_Os_00695]) · 📄 PDF · ↗ Im Modul Os
Konstituierend · function
StatusType ReleaseSpinlock (SpinlockIdType SpinlockId);

Release Spinlock releases a spinlock variable that was occupied before. Before terminating a TASK all spinlock variables that have been occupied with Get Spinlock() shall be released. Before calling Wait EVENT all Spinlocks shall be released.

Konstituierend · function
StatusType TryToGetSpinlock (SpinlockIdType SpinlockId, TryToGetSpinlockType* Success);

Try To Get Spinlock has the same functionality as Get Spinlock with the difference that if the spinlock is already occupied by a TASK on a d ifferent core the function sets the OUT parameter "Success" and returns with E_ OK.

AUTOSAR_SWS_OS ([SWS_Os_00713]) · 📄 PDF · ↗ Im Modul Os
Konstituierend · function
void ShutdownAllCores (StatusType Error);

After this service the OS on all AUTOSAR cores is shut down. Allowed at TASK level and ISR level and also internally by the OS. The function will never return. The function will force other cores into a shutdown.

Konstituierend · function
StatusType ControlIdle (CoreIdType Core ID, IdleModeType IdleMode);

This API allows the caller to select the idle mode action which is performed during idle time of t he OS (e.g. if no Task/ ISR is active). It can be used to implement energy savings. The real idle modes are hardware dependent and not standardized. The default idle mode on each core is IDLE_ NO_ HALT.

Unbewertet
AUTOSAR_SWS_OS ([SWS_Os_00784]) · 📄 PDF · ↗ Im Modul Os
Konstituierend · type

This type describes the status of a schedule. The status can be one of the following: o The schedule table is not started (SCHEDULETABLE_ STOPPED) o The schedule table will be started after the end of currently running schedule table (sched ule table was used in Next Schedule Table() service) (SCHEDULETABLE_ NEXT) o The schedule table uses explicit synchronization, has been started and is waiting for the global time. (SCHEDULETABLE_ WAITING) o The schedule table is running, but is currently n ot synchronous to a global time source (SCHEDULETABLE_ RUNNING) o The schedule table is running and is synchronous to a global time source (SCHEDULETABLE_ RUNNING_ AND_ SYNCHRONOUS)

void EcuM_ErrorHook (uint16 reason);

The ECU State Manager will call the error hook if the error codes "ECUM_E_RAM_CHECK_ FAILED" or "ECUM_E_CONFIGURATION_DATA_INCONSISTENT" occur. In this situation it is not possible to continue processing and the ECU must be stopped. The integrator may choose the modality how the ECU is stopped, i.e. reset, halt, restart, safe state etc.

This API is called by any SW Module whose wakeup source is checked asynchronously (e.g. asynchronous Can Trcv Driver) and the Check of the Wakeup returns a negative Result (no Wakeup by this Source). The API cancels the CheckWakeupTimer for the WakeupSource. If the correponding CheckWakeupTimer is canceled the check of this wakeup source is finished.

Konstituierend · function
uint8 EcuM_CheckRamHash (void);

This callout is intended to provide a RAM integrity test. The goal of this test is to ensure that after a long SLEEP duration, RAM contents is still consistent. The check does not need to be exhaustive since this would consume quite some processing time during wakeups. A well designed check will execute quickly and detect RAM integrity defects with a sufficient probability. This specification does not make any assumption about the algorithm chosen for a particular ECU. The areas of RAM which will be checked have to be chosen carefully. It depends on the check algorithm itself and the task structure. Stack contents of the task executing the RAM check e.g. very likely cannot be checked. It is good practice to have the hash generation and checking in the same task and that this task is not preemptible and that there is only little activity between hash generation and hash check. The RAM check itself is provided by the system designer. In case of applied multi core and existence of Satellite-Ecu M(s): this API will be called by the Master-EcuM only.

Konstituierend · type

EcuM_WakeupSourceType defines a bitfield with 5 pre-defined positions (see Range). The bitfield provides one bit for each wakeup source. In WAKEUP, all bits cleared indicates that no wakeup source is known. In STARTUP, all bits cleared indicates that no reason for restart or reset is known. In this case, ECUM_WKSOURCE_RESET shall be assumed.

=== SYSTEM PROMPT ===
Du bist der KI-Kurations-Assistent des Dokumentationssystems autodocs (AUTOSAR).
Verfasse den Cluster-Leitfaden (<div class="ai cluster-guide">) für das Modulcluster 'System Services' (Module: bswm, ecum, wdgm, wdg) der Classic Platform im Release R20-11.

RICHTLINIEN (bindend):
# Richtlinien für KI-generierte Erklärungen

Diese Datei wird von den Prompt-Rezepten (`_src/tools/prompt_recipes.py`)
wörtlich in jeden Prompt eingebettet. Jede Änderung ändert daher alle
Prompt-Hashes; bestehende KI-Texte gelten dann als veraltet und werden neu
erzeugt. Herkunft und Ablage der Ausgaben regelt `_src/lib_ai_store.py`.

## Sprache

- Kanonische Sprache ist Deutsch. Die Übersetzung ist ein nachgelagerter Schritt
  und nie Teil der Generierung.
- API-Bezeichner, Typnamen, Enum-Werte, Code und Kennungen wie `[SWS_…]` bleiben
  unverändert.

## Struktur

- Jedes Fragment ist genau ein `<div class="ai …">` (Varianten: `ai usage` für
  Verwendungshinweise an einem Spezifikationselement, `ai module-guide` für
  Modul-Leitfäden) und endet mit genau einem `<p class="ai-note">` (KI-Hinweis).
- Erlaubte Elemente im Fragment: `div`, `p`, `h4`, `ul`, `ol`, `li`, `code`,
  `strong`, `em`, `a`, `span`, `table`, `thead`, `tbody`, `tr`, `th`, `td`.
  Keine Skripte, keine Stile, keine Bilder, kein `<svg>` (Diagramme siehe unten).
- Alle Tags korrekt geschlossen und verschachtelt.

## Belegpflicht

- Jede fachliche Aussage ist zu belegen. Belege stammen ausschließlich aus dem
  Payload des Prompts; nichts darf aus anderem Wissen als Beleg ausgegeben werden.
- Verweis auf ein Spezifikationselement oder Requirement (nur IDs, die im
  Payload vorkommen):
  `<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_…">[SWS_…]</a>` — ohne `href`; den
  Link setzt der Generator.
- Verweis auf eine Dokumentstelle (nur Dokument/Seite aus dem Payload):
  `<span class="docref" data-doc="<Dokument-ID>" data-page="<Seite>">Kurzname §x.y „Titel“</span>`.
- Niemals URLs ausgeben, insbesondere keine PDF-URLs.

## Annahmen (Wissenslücken)

- Wo die Quellen schweigen, sind höchstens 3 Annahmen je Text und 2 je
  Diagramm erlaubt.
- Jede Annahme ist im Text als Interpretation erkennbar („dürfte“, „vermutlich“,
  „Interpretation:“) und wird am Ende des Fragments in einem Kommentar
  `<!-- annahmen: 1) … – Begründung: … -->` aufgezählt.
- Reicht das Budget nicht, wird der Aspekt weggelassen — niemals unmarkiert
  spekulieren.

## Diagramme

Ein Diagramm nur, wenn es gegenüber dem Text Mehrwert bietet:

- Sequenzdiagramm: Abläufe ab 3 Schritten oder mit nicht offensichtlicher
  Reihenfolge/Asynchronität.
- Kontext-/Kollaborationsdiagramm: ab 3 beteiligten Komponenten.
- Zustandsdiagramm: Lebenszyklen und Zustandsmaschinen.
- Aktivitätsdiagramm: Entscheidungs- oder Verarbeitungsabläufe mit Verzweigung.
- Keine Trivialdiagramme (einzelne Aufrufe, Getter/Setter, Zweierbeziehungen).

Beschriftungen deutsch, Bezeichner unverändert. Jedes Diagramm steht im
Fragment als Platzhalter `<div class="diagram" id="diag-<kurzname>"></div>`,
direkt gefolgt von `<p class="diagram-note"><Diagrammart>: <Kernaussage>.
Quellen: <Belege></p>`. Die Diagrammquelle wird separat ausgegeben (Format
legt der Prompt fest).

LEITBILD FÜR CLUSTER-LEITFÄDEN (AUTOSAR Classic Platform):
- 800–1500 Wörter in 4–7 thematischen Abschnitten mit <h4>-Überschriften:
  1. Systemarchitektur & Rolle des Modulclusters (Zweck, beteiligte BSW-Module und Standards wie ISO 14229, ISO 15765, AUTOSAR BSW-Schichten).
  2. Zusammenspiel & Interaktionspfade zwischen den Modulen (Nachrichten-/Datenfluss, Aufrufketten, Puffer-/Statusübergabe).
  3. Synchronisation, Reentranz und Task-Kontexte (MainFunctions, Interrupt-Kontext vs. Task-Ebene, Exklusive Bereiche).
  4. Typische Lebenszyklen und Betriebsmodi (Initialisierungsreihenfolge, Moduswechsel, Shutdown/Sleep/Wakeup).
  5. Fehlerbehandlung, Det-Tracing und Degradation (Fehlererkennung, DEM-Fehlerspeicher, Fallback-Strategien).
- Jeder Absatz enthält mindestens einen Beleg (Requirement-ID oder Dokumentstelle).
- 1–3 Diagramme: Sequenzdiagramm für modulinternes Zusammenspiel oder dot-Architekturdiagramm.
- Das Fragment beginnt mit <div class="ai cluster-guide"> und endet mit <p class="ai-note">…</p></div>.

AUSGABEFORMAT (verbindlich, nichts außerhalb dieser Blöcke):
<<<FRAGMENT
<div class="…"> … </div>
FRAGMENT>>>
Danach je Diagramm-Platzhalter genau ein Block:
<<<DIAGRAM diag-<kurzname> seq
<JSON nach dem Sequenz-Schema>
DIAGRAM>>>
oder
<<<DIAGRAM diag-<kurzname> dot
<Graphviz-digraph ohne Stilattribute (Farben/Schriften setzt der Generator)>
DIAGRAM>>>

Sequenz-Schema (JSON):
{"titel": str, "teilnehmer": [{"name": str}], "schritte": [
  {"art": "nachricht", "von": <idx>, "nach": <idx>, "text": [str], "pfeil": "voll"|"offen", "gestrichelt": bool},
  {"art": "selbst", "teilnehmer": <idx>, "text": [str]},
  {"art": "notiz", "ueber": [<idx>, <idx>], "text": [str]},
  {"art": "abschnitt", "text": str},
  {"art": "rahmen", "typ": "alt"|"opt"|"loop", "guard": str}, {"art": "trenner", "guard": str}, {"art": "rahmen-ende"}
]}
Antworten/Rückgaben: "pfeil": "offen", "gestrichelt": true. Zustands-, Kontext- und Aktivitätsdiagramme als dot.

  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_00624",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "The EcuM_SelectShutdownTarget function shall set the shut- down target to the value of the shutdownTarget parameter."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_01117",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "EcuM_SetWakeupEvent sets (OR-operation) all events passed as a bit set in the sources in parameter ( EcuM_WakeupSourceType bitmask) in the internal pending wakeup events variable."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_01156",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "EcuM_GetPendingWakeupEvents shall return wakeup events which have been set to pending but not yet validated as bits set in a EcuM_- WakeupSourceType bitmask."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_02156",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "EcuM_GetLastShutdownTarget shall return the ECU state from which the last wakeup or power up occurred in the shutdownTarget parameter. EcuM_ GetLastShutdownTarget shall always return the same value until the next shutd…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_02157",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "EcuM_GetLastShutdownTarget may return a shutdown target in a STARTUP phase that set late in a previous SHUTDOWN phase. If so, implementation specific limitations shall be clearly documented."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_02165",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "Additional wakeup sources (to the pre-defined sources) shall be assigned individually to bitfield positions 5 to 31 by configuration. The bit assignment shall be done by the configuration tool."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_02166",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "The EcuMWakeupSourceId (see ECUC_EcuM_00151) field in the EcuMWakeupSource container shall define the position corresponding to that wakeup source in all instances the EcuM_WakeupSourceType bitfield."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_02171",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "EcuM_SetWakeupEvent must be callable from interrupt con- text, from OS context and an OS-free context."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_02172",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "EcuM_GetPendingWakeupEvents shall be callable from in- terrupt context, from OS context and an OS-free context."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_02181",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "The ECU Manager module shall call EcuM_GetValidated- WakeupEvents with the configured default shutdown target ( EcuMDefaultShut- downTarget )."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_02185",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "The parameter mode of the function EcuM_SelectShutdown Target shall be the identifier of a sleep or reset mode. The mode parameter shall only be used if the target parameter equals ECUM_SHUTDOWN_TARGET_SLEEP or ECUM_SH…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_02188",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "No wakeup event shall be missed in the SLEEP phase. The Halt or Poll Sequences shall not be entered if a wakeup event has occurred in the Go Sleep sequence."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_02247",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "The service EcuM_SelectBootTarget shall store the se- lected target in a way that is compatible with the boot loader."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_02336",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "If the call of GetLastShutdownTarget() passes ECU_STATE_ SLEEP in the parameter shutdownTarget, in the parameter shutdownMode it returns which of the configured sleep modes was actually chosen. 112 of 210 Document ID 7…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_02337",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "If the pointer to the shutdownMode parameter is NULL, Ecu M_GetLastShutdownTarget shall simply ignore the shutdownMode parameter and re- turn the last shutdown target regardless of whether it was SLEEP or not. If Devel…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_02345",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "EcuM_ValidateWakeupEvent shall be callable from interrupt context and task context."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_02389",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "To set the wakeup sources up for the next sleep mode, the ECU Manager module shall execute the EcuM_EnableWakeupSources callout (see [SWS_EcuM_02546] ) for each wakeup source that is configured in EcuMWakeup- SourceMas…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_02411",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "Table StartPreOS Sequence shows the activities in StartPre OS Sequence and the order in which they shall be executed in EcuM_Init (see [SWS_EcuM_02811] )."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_02479",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "The ECU Manager module shall execute the Wakeup Valida- tion Protocol upon the EcuM_SetWakeupEvent (see [SWS_EcuM_02826] ) function call according to Interaction of Wakeup Sources and the ECU Manager later in this chap…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_02496",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "If the wakeup event is validated (either immediately or by the wakeup validation protocol), the ECU Manager module shall make the information that it is a source of the current ECU wakeup through the EcuM_GetValidatedW…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_02532",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "EcuM_GetValidatedWakeupEvent shall be callable from in- terrupt context, from OS context and an OS-free context."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_02533",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "EcuM_GetValidatedWakeupEvent shall return wakeup events which have been set to validated in the internal validated events variable as bits set in a EcuM_WakeupSourceType bitmask."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_02539",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "If the ECU Manager module has a list of wakeup source can- didates when the WakeupRestart Sequence has finished, the ECU Manager module shall validate these wakeup source candidates in EcuM_MainFunction ."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_02546",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "The ECU Manager module shall derive the wakeup sources to be enabled (and used as the wakeupSource parameter) from the EcuMWakeupSource (see ECUC_EcuM_00152) bitfield configured for the current sleep mode."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_02559",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "The configuration of the ECU Manager module shall spec- ify the order of initialization calls inside init block 0 and init block 1. (see EcuM- DriverInitListZero and EcuMDriverInitListOne )."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_02561",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "The ECU Manager module shall initialize the drivers in Ecu MDriverRestartList in the same order as in the combined list of init block 0 and init block 1."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_02562",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "EcuMDriverRestartList may contain drivers that serve as wakeup sources. EcuM_AL_DriverRestart shall re-arm the trigger mechanism of these drivers' 'wakeup detected' callback."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_02565",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "The ECU Manager module shall start a validation timeout for each pending wakeup event that should be validated. The timeout shall be event- specific (see EcuMValidationTimeout )."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_02566",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "The ECU Manager module shall only invoke wakeup validation on those wakeup sources where it is required by configuration. If the validation protocol 60 of 210 Document ID 78: AUTOSAR_SWS_ECUStateManager Specification o…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_02572",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "The ECU Manager module shall detect wakeups that occurr prior to driver initialization, both from Halt/Poll or from OFF."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_02585",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "EcuM_SelectShutdownTarget shall not initiate any setup activi- ties but only store the value for later use in the SHUTDOWN or SLEEP phase."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_02589",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "EcuM_GetExpiredWakeupEvents shall be callable from in- terrupt context, from OS context and an OS-free context."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_02601",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "If the EcuM cannot determine the reset reason returned by the Mcu driver, then the EcuM set a wakeup event for default wakeup source ECUM_ WKSOURCE_RESET instead."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_02603",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "The StartPreOS Sequence shall initialize all basic software modules that are needed to start the OS."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_02623",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "The ECU Manager module shall remember the wakeup source resulting from the reset reason translation (see table StartPreOS Sequence )."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_02625",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "The ECU Manager module shall never invoke validation for the following wakeup sources: • ECUM_WKSOURCE_POWER • ECUM_WKSOURCE_RESET • ECUM_WKSOURCE_INTERNAL_RESET 63 of 210 Document ID 78: AUTOSAR_SWS_ECUStateManager Sp…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_02645",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "EcuM_ValidateWakeupEvent shall invoke ComM_EcuM_ WakeUpIndication for each wakeup event if the EcuMComMChannelRef parameter (see ECUC_EcuM_00101) in the EcuMWakeupSource configuration container for the corresponding wa…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_02664",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "The ECU Manager module shall define all states as listed in the EcuM_StateType."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_02683",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "EcuM_ClearWakeupEvent clears all pending events passed as a bit set in the sources in parameter (EcuM_WakeupSourceType bitmask) from the internal pending wakeup events variable, the internal validated events variable a…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_02684",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "When activated through the EcuM_Init (see [SWS_EcuM_02811] ) function, the ECU Manager module shall perform the ac- tions in the StartPreOS Sequence (see table StartPreOS Sequence )."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_02707",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "EcuM_SetWakeupEvent shall start the wakeup validation timeout timer according to Wakeup Validation Timeout ."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_02709",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "The ECU Manager module shall start the wakeup validation timeout timer when EcuM_SetWakeupEvent (see [SWS_EcuM_02826] ) is called."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_02710",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "EcuM_ValidateWakeupEvent shall stop the wakeup valida- tion timeout timer (see [SWS_EcuM_02829] )."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_02712",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "If EcuM_SetWakeupEvent (see [SWS_EcuM_02826] ) is called subsequently for the same wakeup source, the ECU Manager module shall not restart the wakeup validation timeout."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_02730",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "The ECU Manager module shall call each driver's init function with the parameters derived from the driver's EcuMModuleService configuration con- tainer."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_02756",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "When a wakeup event occurs during the shutdown phase, the ECU Manager module shall complete the shutdown and restart immediately there- after."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_02788",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "If the pointer to the shutdownMode parameter is NULL, EcuM_ GetShutdownTarget shall simply ignore the shutdownMode parameter. If Development Error Detection is activated, EcuM_GetShutdownTarget shall send the ECUM_E_ P…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_02790",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "EcuM_ValidateWakeupEvent shall return without effect for all sources except communication channels when called while the ECU Manager mod- ule is in the RUN state."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_02791",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "EcuM_ValidateWakeupEvent shall have full effect in any ECU Phase for those sources that correspond to a communication channel (see [SWS_EcuM_02645])."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_02794",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "The structure defined in the EcuM_ConfigType type shall con- tain an additional post-build configuration variant identifier (uint8/uint16/uint32 depend- ing on algorithm to compute the identifier)."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_02795",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "The structure defined by the EcuM_ConfigType type shall con- tain an additional hash code that is tested against the configuration parameter EcuM- ConfigConsistencyHash for checking consistency of the configuration dat…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_02796",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "The ECU Manager module shall not only check the consistency of its own parameters but of all post-build configurable BSW modules before initializing the first BSW module."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_02798",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "The ECU Manager module shall check in EcuM_Init (see [SWS_EcuM_02811] ) that the field in the structure is equal to the value of ECUM_ CONFIGCONSISTENCY_HASH ."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_02799",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "The hash computation algorithm used to compute a hash value over all pre-compile and link-time configuration parameters of all BSW modules shall always produce the same hash value for the same set of configuration data…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_02801",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "The structure defined by type EcuM_ConfigType shall hold the post-build configuration parameters for the ECU Manager module as well as pointers to all ConfigType structures of modules that are initialized by the ECU Ma…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_02806",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "Caveats of EcuM_StartupTwo: This function must be called from a task, which is started directly as a consequence of StartOS. I.e. either the EcuM_StartupTwo function must be called from an autostart task or the EcuM_St…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_02807",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "EcuM_ClearWakeupEvent shall be callable from interrupt con- text, from OS context and an OS-free context."
  },

  },

   "text": "API Function Header File Description Adc_Init Adc.h Initializes the ADC hardware units and driver. Can_Init Can.h This function initializes the module. CanTrcv_Init CanTrcv.h Initializes the CanTrcv module. Det_Init De…"

  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_02863",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "The ECU Manager module shall invoke the EcuM_Generat- eRamHash (see [SWS_EcuM_02919] ) callout before halting the microcontroller the 49 of 210 Document ID 78: AUTOSAR_SWS_ECUStateManager Specification of ECU State Man…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_02867",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "If Development Error Reporting is turned on and parame- ter \"sources\" contains an unknown (unconfigured) wakeup source, EcuM_SetWake- upEvent shall not update its internal variable and shall send the ECUM_E_UN- KNOWN_W…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_02868",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "If Development Error Reporting is turned on and the sources parameter contains an unknown (unconfigured) wakeup source, EcuM_Validate- WakeupEvent shall ignore the call and send the ECUM_E_UNKNOWN_WAKEUP_ SOURCE error…"
  },

  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_02932",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "When activated through the EcuM_StartupTwo (see [SWS_EcuM_02838] ) function, the ECU Manager module shall perform the actions in StartPostOS Sequence (see table 7.2)."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_02947",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "For re-initialization during WakeupRestart, the integrator shall integrate a restart block into the integration code for EcuM_AL_DriverRestart (see [SWS_EcuM_02923] ) using the EcuMDriverRestartList ."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_02951",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "In contrast to the SHUTDOWN phase, the ECU Manager mod- ule shall not shut down the OS when entering the SLEEP phase. The sleep mode, i.e. combination of the EcuM SLEEP phase and the Mcu Mode, shall be transparent to t…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_02952",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "As its last activity, the ECU Manager module shall call the Shut- downOS function."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_02953",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "The shutdown hook shall call EcuM_Shutdown (see [SWS_EcuM_02812] ) to terminate the shutdown process. EcuM_Shutdown (see [SWS_EcuM_02812] ) shall not return but switch off the ECU or issue a reset."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_02957",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "The ECU Manager module may define a configurable set of sleep modes (see EcuMSleepMode ) where each mode itself is a shutdown target."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_02958",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "The ECU Manager module shall allow mapping the MCU sleep modes to ECU sleep modes and hence allow them to be addressed as shutdown tar- gets."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_02960",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "The ECU Manager module shall execute the Halt Sequence in sleep modes that halt the microcontroller. In these sleep modes the ECU Manager module does not execute any code."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_02961",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "The ECU Manager module shall invoke the EcuM_Generat- eRamHash (see [SWS_EcuM_02919] ) where the system designer can place a RAM integrity check."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_02962",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "The ECU Manager module shall execute the Poll Sequence in sleep modes that reduce the power consumption of the microcontroller but still execute code."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_02963",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "If a wakeup event (e.g. toggling a wakeup line, communication on a CAN bus etc.) occurs while the ECU is in Halt or Poll, then the ECU Manager module shall regain control and exit the SLEEP phase by executing the Wakeu…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_02975",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "If a wakeup event requires validation then the ECU Manager module shall invoke the validation protocol"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_02976",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "If a wakeup event does not require validation, the ECU Man- ager module shall issue a mode switch request to set the event's mode to ECUM_ WKSTATUS_VALIDATED."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_02979",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "The shutdownMode parameter shall determine the specific sleep or reset mode (see ECUC_EcuM_00132) relevant to SelectShutdownTarget, GetShutdownTarget and GetLastShutdownTarget. The ECU Manager module shall only use the…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_02980",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "The ECU Manager module shall ignore all types of errors that occur during initialization, e.g. values returned by init functions"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_02987",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "When the RAM check fails on wakeup the ECU Manager mod- ule shall invoke EcuM_ErrorHook with the parameter ECUM_E_RAM_CHECK_FAILED . It is left integrator's discretion to allow EcuM_ErrorHook to relay the error to the…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_02990",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "The ECU Manager module implementation shall provide a sin- gle EcuM_Callout_Stubs.c file which contains the stubs of the callouts realized in this implementation."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_03000",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "Caveat for the function EcuM_SelectBootTarget : This ser- vice may depend on the boot loader used. This service is only intended for use by SW-C's related to diagnostics (boot management)."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_03003",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "Caveat of EcuM_GetPendingWakeupEvents : This function only returns the wakeup events with status ECUM_WKSTATUS_PENDING."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_03009",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "If Development Error Detection is enabled for this module, then all functions shall test input parameters and running conditions and use the following error codes in an adequate way: • ECUM_E_UNINIT • ECUM_E_SERVICE_DI…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_03010",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "When operating on a multicore ECU ECUM shall reserve a ded- icated resource (RES_AUTOSAR_ECUM) for each core, which is allocated during Go Sleep."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_03011",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "Name EcuM_ShutdownTarget Comment A SW-C can select a shutdown target using this interface IsService true Variation  0 E_OK Operation successful Possible Errors 1 E_NOT_OK Operation failed 142 of 210 Document ID 78: AU…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_03012",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "Name EcuM_BootTarget Comment A SW-C that wants to select a boot target must use the client-server interface EcuM_Boot Target. IsService true Variation  0 E_OK Operation successful Possible Errors 1 E_NOT_OK Operation…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_03017",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "Name AlarmClock_{UserName} Kind ProvidedPort Interface EcuM_AlarmClock Description Provides to SW-Cs an alarm clock. The EcuM_AlarmClock port uses port-defined argument values to identify the user that manages its alar…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_03018",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "The definition of the internal behavior of the the ECU Manager module shall be as follows. This detailed description is only needed for the configura- tion of the local RTE. InternalBehavior EcuStateManager { // Runnab…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_03019",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "ECUM_E_EARLIER_ACTIVE and ECUM_E_PAST shall be of type Std_ReturnType and represent the following values • ECUM_E_EARLIER_ACTIVE = 3 • ECUM_E_PAST = 4"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_03020",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "In the Poll sequence the EcuM shall call the callouts EcuM_- SleepActivity and EcuM_CheckWakeup () in a blocking loop until a pending/vali- dated wakeup event is reported."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_03021",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "See 7.4"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_03022",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "The SHUTDOWN phase handles the controlled shutdown of basic software modules and finally results in the selected shutdown target OFF or RESET."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_03023",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "If development error detection is enabled and EcuM_Re- leaseRUN did not find a previous matching request for the provided user, then the function shall report ECUM_E_MISMATCHED_RUN_RELEASE to Det."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_03024",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "If development error detection is enabled and there are multiple requests by the same user detected by EcuM_RequestRUN the function shall report ECUM_E_MULTIPLE_RUN_REQUESTS to Det."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_03025",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "If development error detection is enabled and there are multiple requests by the same user detected by EcuM_RequestPOST_RUN the function shall report ECUM_E_MULTIPLE_RUN_REQUESTS to Det."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_03026",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "If development error detection is enabled and EcuM_Release- POST_RUN did not find a previous matching request for the provided user, then the function shall report ECUM_E_MISMATCHED_RUN_RELEASE to Det."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_04001",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "If irregular events (a hardware reset or a power cycle) occur while the ECU is in Halt or Poll, the ECU Manager module shall restart the ECU in the STARTUP phase."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_04002",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "When the Alarm Clock service is present (see EcuMAlarm- ClockPresent ) the EcuM_MainFunction shall update the Alarm Clock Timer"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_04003",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "When an ECU Manager action causes the state of a wakeup source to change, the ECU Manager module shall issue a mode request to the BswM to change the wakeup source's mode to the new the wakeup source state."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_04004",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "The ECU Manager Module shall either provide a single wakeup validation timeout timer or one timer per wakeup source."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_04005",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "The ECU Manager module shall define a configurable set of reset modes (see EcuMResetMode and EcuM_ResetType ), where each mode itself is a shutdown target. The set will minimally contain targets for • Mcu_PerformReset…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_04006",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "The ECU Manager module shall allow defining aliases for reset targets (See EcuM180_Conf)."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_04007",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "The ECU Manager module shall define a configurable set of reset causes (see EcuMShutdownCause and EcuM_ShutdownCauseType ). The set shall minimally contain targets for • ECU state machine entered a shutdown state • Wdg…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_04008",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "The ECU Manager Module shall offer facilities to BSW modules and SW-Cs to • Record a shutdown cause • Get a set of recent shutdown causes"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_04009",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "When leaving the Sleep state the ECU Manager Module will abort any active user alarm clock and the master alarm clock. This means that both clock induced and wakeups due to other events will result in clearing all alar…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_04010",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "User alarms and the master alarm shall be cancelled during the StartPreOS Sequence, in the WakeupRestart Sequence and the OffPreOS Se- quence."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_04011",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "The EcuM_MainFunction shall run in all EcuM instances."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_04012",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "Each instance of the ECU Manager module shall process the wakeup events of its core."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_04014",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "The ECU Manager module shall call BswM_Init for all core local BswMs on the master and all slave cores."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_04015",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "74 of 210 Document ID 78: AUTOSAR_SWS_ECUStateManager Specification of ECU State Manager AUTOSAR CP R20-11 Figure 7.19: Master Core StartPreOS Sequence"
  },

   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "75 of 210 Document ID 78: AUTOSAR_SWS_ECUStateManager Specification of ECU State Manager AUTOSAR CP R20-11 Figure 7.20: Master Core StartPostOS Sequence"

   "text": "76 of 210 Document ID 78: AUTOSAR_SWS_ECUStateManager Specification of ECU State Manager AUTOSAR CP R20-11 Figure 7.21: Slave Core StartPreOS Sequence"

  {

   "text": "82 of 210 Document ID 78: AUTOSAR_SWS_ECUStateManager Specification of ECU State Manager AUTOSAR CP R20-11 Figure 7.26: Slave Core OffPostOS Sequence"

  },
  {

   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "84 of 210 Document ID 78: AUTOSAR_SWS_ECUStateManager Specification of ECU State Manager AUTOSAR CP R20-11 Figure 7.28: Master Core Halt Sequence 85 of 210 Document ID 78: AUTOSAR_SWS_ECUStateManager Specification of E…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_04025",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "Figure 7.29: Master Core Poll Sequence"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_04026",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "86 of 210 Document ID 78: AUTOSAR_SWS_ECUStateManager Specification of ECU State Manager AUTOSAR CP R20-11 Figure 7.30: Master Core WakeupRestart Sequence"
  },
  {

   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "87 of 210 Document ID 78: AUTOSAR_SWS_ECUStateManager Specification of ECU State Manager AUTOSAR CP R20-11 Figure 7.31: Slave Core GoSleep Sequence"
  },

   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "88 of 210 Document ID 78: AUTOSAR_SWS_ECUStateManager Specification of ECU State Manager AUTOSAR CP R20-11 Figure 7.32: Slave Core Halt Sequence"

   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "89 of 210 Document ID 78: AUTOSAR_SWS_ECUStateManager Specification of ECU State Manager AUTOSAR CP R20-11 Figure 7.33: Slave Core Poll Sequence"
  },
  {

   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "90 of 210 Document ID 78: AUTOSAR_SWS_ECUStateManager Specification of ECU State Manager AUTOSAR CP R20-11 Figure 7.34: Slave Core WakeupRestart Sequence"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_04032",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "Type of error Related error code Error value Multiple requests by the same user were detected ECUM_E_MULTIPLE_RUN_REQUESTS Assigned by Implementation A function was called which was disabled by configuration ECUM_E_SER…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_04033",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "In the unrecoverable error situations defined in the first column of Table in [SWS_EcuM_04032], the ECU Manager module shall call the EcuM_Er- rorHook callout with the parameter value set to the corresponding related e…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_04038",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "Name EcuM_ConfigType Kind Structure - Type  Elements Comment The content of this structure depends on the post-build configuration of EcuM. Description A pointer to such a structure shall be provided to the ECU State…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_04040",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "Name EcuM_WakeupSourceType Kind Type Derived from uint32 ECUM_WKSOURCE_POWER 0x01 Power cycle (bit 0) ECUM_WKSOURCE_RESET (default) 0x02 Hardware reset (bit 1). If the Mcu driver cannot distinguish between a power cycl…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_04041",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "Name EcuM_WakeupStatusType Kind Type Derived from uint8 ECUM_WKSTATUS_NONE 0 No pending wakeup event was detected ECUM_WKSTATUS_PENDING 1 The wakeup event was detected but not yet validated ECUM_WKSTATUS_VALIDATED 2 Th…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_04044",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "Name EcuM_ResetType Kind Type Derived from uint8 ECUM_RESET_MCU 0 Microcontroller reset via Mcu_ PerformReset ECUM_RESET_WDG 1 Watchdog reset via WdgM_ PerformReset Range ECUM_RESET_IO 2 Reset by toggeling an I/O line.…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_04045",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "Name EcuM_ShutdownCauseType Kind Type Derived from uint8 ECUM_CAUSE_UNKNOWN 0 No cause was set. ECUM_CAUSE_ECU_STATE 1 ECU state machine entered a state for shutdown ECUM_CAUSE_WDGM 2 Watchdog Manager detected a failur…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_04050",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "Service Name EcuM_SelectShutdownCause Syntax Std_ReturnType EcuM_SelectShutdownCause ( EcuM_ShutdownCauseType target ) Service ID [hex] 0x1b Sync/Async Synchronous Reentrancy Reentrant Parameters (in) target The select…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_04051",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "113 of 210 Document ID 78: AUTOSAR_SWS_ECUStateManager Specification of ECU State Manager AUTOSAR CP R20-11 Service Name EcuM_GetShutdownCause Syntax Std_ReturnType EcuM_GetShutdownCause ( EcuM_ShutdownCauseType * shut…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_04054",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "Service Name EcuM_SetRelWakeupAlarm Syntax Std_ReturnType EcuM_SetRelWakeupAlarm ( EcuM_UserType user, EcuM_TimeType time ) Service ID [hex] 0x22 Sync/Async Synchronous Reentrancy Reentrant user The user that wants to…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_04055",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "If the relative time from now is earlier than the current wakeup time, EcuM_SetRelWakeupAlarm shall update the wakeup time."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_04056",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "If the relative time from now is later than the current wakeup time, EcuM_SetRelWakeupAlarm shall not update the wakeup time and shall return ECUM_E_EARLIER_ACTIVE."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_04057",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "Service Name EcuM_SetAbsWakeupAlarm Syntax Std_ReturnType EcuM_SetAbsWakeupAlarm ( EcuM_UserType user, EcuM_TimeType time ) Service ID [hex] 0x23 Sync/Async Synchronous Reentrancy Reentrant user The user that wants to…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_04058",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "If the time parameter is earlier than the current wakeup time, EcuM_SetAbsWakeupAlarm shall update the wakeup time."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_04059",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "If the time parameter is later than the current wakeup time, EcuM_SetAbsWakeupAlarm shall not update the wakeup time and shall return ECUM_E_EARLIER_ACTIVE."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_04060",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "If the time parameter is earlier than now, EcuM_SetAbsWake- upAlarm shall not update the wakeup time and shall return ECUM_E_PAST."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_04061",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "118 of 210 Document ID 78: AUTOSAR_SWS_ECUStateManager Specification of ECU State Manager AUTOSAR CP R20-11 Service Name EcuM_AbortWakeupAlarm Syntax Std_ReturnType EcuM_AbortWakeupAlarm ( EcuM_UserType user ) Service…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_04062",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "Service Name EcuM_GetCurrentTime Syntax Std_ReturnType EcuM_GetCurrentTime ( EcuM_TimeType * time ) Service ID [hex] 0x25 Sync/Async Synchronous Reentrancy Reentrant Parameters (in) None Parameters (inout) None Paramet…"
  },
  {

  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_04064",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "Service Name EcuM_SetClock Syntax Std_ReturnType EcuM_SetClock ( EcuM_UserType user, EcuM_TimeType time ) Service ID [hex] 0x27 Sync/Async Synchronous Reentrancy Reentrant user User that wants to set the clock Paramete…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_04065",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "Service Name EcuM_AL_Reset Syntax void EcuM_AL_Reset ( EcuM_ResetType reset ) Service ID [hex] 0x4C Sync/Async Synchronous Reentrancy Non Reentrant Parameters (in) reset Type of reset to be performed. Parameters (inout…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_04066",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "Figure 7.14: WakeupRestart Sequence"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_04069",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "When the Alarm Clock service is present (see EcuMAlarm- ClockPresent ) the EcuM Manager module shall maintain an EcuM clock whose time shall be the time in seconds since battery connect."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_04070",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "Each EcuM User shall have at most one user alarm clock."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_04071",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "An EcuM User shall not be able to set the value of another user's alarm clock."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_04072",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "The ECU Manager module shall set always the master alarm clock value to the value of the earliest user alarm clock value."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_04073",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "Only authorized EcuM Users can set the EcuM clock time (see EcuMSetClockAllowedUsers )."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_04074",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "When the shutdown target is RESET, the ECU Manager module shall call the EcuM_AL_Reset callout."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_04075",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "When the shutdown target is OFF, the ECU Manager module shall call the EcuM_AL_SwitchOff callout."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_04076",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "EcuM_GetExpiredWakeupEvents shall return wakeup events which have been set to validated in the internal expired events variable as bits set in a EcuM_WakeupSourceType bitmask."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_04078",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "EcuM_ValidateWakeupEvent sets (OR-operation) all events passed as a bit set in the sources in parameter (EcuM_WakeupSourceType bitmask) in the internal validated wakeup events variable."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_04079",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "EcuMValidateWakeupEvent shall invoke BswM_EcuM_Current Wakeup with its sources parameter and state value ECUM_WKSTATUS_VALIDATED."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_04080",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "The ECU Manager module shall derive the wakeup sources to be checked (and used as the wakeupSource parameter) from the EcuMWakeup Source (see ECUC_EcuM_00152) bitfield configured for the current sleep mode. The integra…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_04081",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "When the validation timeout expires for a pending wakeup event, the EcuM_MainFunction sets (OR-operation) set the bit in the internal expired wakeup events variable."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_04082",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "When the validation timeout expires for a pending wakeup event, the EcuM_MainFunction shall invoke BswM_EcuM_Current_Wakeup with an EcuM_WakeupSourceType bitmask parameter with the bit corresponding to the wakeup event…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_04084",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "The ECU Manager module shall derive the wakeup sources to be disabled (and used as the wakeupSource parameter) from the internal pend- ing events variable (NOT operation). The integration code used for this callout mus…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_04085",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "Service Name EcuM_AL_SetProgrammableInterrupts Syntax void EcuM_AL_SetProgrammableInterrupts ( void ) Service ID [hex] 0x4A Sync/Async Asynchronous Reentrancy Non Reentrant Parameters (in) None Parameters (inout) None…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_04086",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "The EcuM clock shall track time in the UP and SLEEP phases."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_04087",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "Hardware permitting, the EcuM clock time shall not be reset by an ECU reset."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_04088",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "There shall be one and only one wakeup source assigned to the EcuM Clock (see EcuMAlarmWakeupSource )."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_04089",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "If the underlying hardware mechanism is tick based, the ECUM shall \"correct\" the time accordingly"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_04091",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "The wakeup sources can be in the following states: State Description NONE No wakeup event was detected or has been cleared. PENDING A wakeup event was detected but not yet validated. VALIDATED A wakeup event was detect…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_04092",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "The ShutdownTarget Sleep shall put the all cores into sleep."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_04093",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "The ECU Manager module shall start the SchM and the OS on every core."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_04094",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "In the case of a MultiCore ECU, the EcuM AUTOSAR service (Standardized AUTOSAR Interfaces) may be offered on one or more cores."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_04095",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "In the case of a MultiCore ECU, the EcuM C-API Interfaces (Standardized Interfaces) which are used by other BSW modules shall be offered in every partition a EcuM runs in."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_04096",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "Service Name EcuM_StartCheckWakeup Syntax void EcuM_StartCheckWakeup ( EcuM_WakeupSourceType WakeupSource ) Service ID [hex] 0x00 Sync/Async Synchronous Reentrancy Non Reentrant Parameters (in) WakeupSource For this wa…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_04098",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "If EcuM_SetWakeupEvent is called for the corresponding wakeup source the CheckWakeupTimer is cancelled."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_04101",

  },

  {

  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_04114",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "EcuM_AL_DriverInitBswM_<x> is generated for every config- ured EcuMDriverInitListBswM. The name of the generated functions shall be EcuM_ AL_DriverInitBswM_<x>, where <x> represents the short name of the EcuMDriverInit…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_04115",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "ECU Mode Handling shall be applied when EcuMModeHan- dling is configured to true."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_04116",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "When the BswM sets a state of the EcuM by EcuM_SetState , the EcuM shall indicate the corresponding mode to the RTE."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_04117",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "When the last RUN request has been released, ECU State Manager module shall indicate this to BswM using the API BswM_EcuM_- RequestedState(ECUM_STATE_APP_RUN, ECUM_RUNSTATUS_RELEASED) ."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_04118",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "When the ECU State Manager is not in the state which is re- quested by a SWC, it shall inform BswM about requested states using the BswM_- EcuM_RequestedState API."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_04119",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "When the last POST_RUN request has been released, ECU State Manager module shall indicate this to BswM using the API BswM_EcuM_Re- questedState(ECUM_STATE_APP_POST_RUN, ECUM_RUNSTATUS_RELEASED) ."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_04120",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "Name EcuM_RunStatusType Kind Type Derived from uint8 ECUM_RUNSTATUS_UNKNOWN 0 Unknown status. Init Value. ECUM_RUNSTATUS_ REQUESTED 1 Status requested from EcuM Range ECUM_RUNSTATUS_ RELEASED 2 Status released from Ecu…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_04121",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "The ECU Manager module shall inform BswM about the state of the Run Request Protocol as listed in the EcuM_RunStatusType."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_04122",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "Service Name EcuM_SetState Syntax void EcuM_SetState ( EcuM_StateType state ) Service ID [hex] 0x2b Sync/Async Synchronous Reentrancy Reentrant Parameters (in) state State indicated by BswM. Parameters (inout) None Par…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_04123",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "The EcuM_SetState function shall set the EcuM State to the value of the State parameter. If the State parameter is not a valid value, the EcuM_SetState function shall not change the State and if Development Error Repor…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_04124",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "Service Name EcuM_RequestRUN Syntax Std_ReturnType EcuM_RequestRUN ( EcuM_UserType user ) Service ID [hex] 0x03 Sync/Async Synchronous Reentrancy Reentrant Parameters (in) user ID of the entity requesting the RUN state…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_04125",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "Requests of EcuM_RequestRUN cannot be nested, i.e. one user can only place one request but not more. Additional or duplicate user requests by the same user shall be reported to DET. Of course the DET will only be notif…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_04126",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "An implementation must track requests for each user known on the ECU. Run requests are specific to the user."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_04127",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "Service Name EcuM_ReleaseRUN Syntax Std_ReturnType EcuM_ReleaseRUN ( EcuM_UserType user ) Service ID [hex] 0x04 Sync/Async Synchronous Reentrancy Reentrant Parameters (in) user ID of the entity releasing the RUN state.…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_04128",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "Service Name EcuM_RequestPOST_RUN Syntax Std_ReturnType EcuM_RequestPOST_RUN ( EcuM_UserType user ) Service ID [hex] 0x0a Sync/Async Synchronous Reentrancy Reentrant Parameters (in) user ID of the entity requesting the…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_04129",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "Service Name EcuM_ReleasePOST_RUN Syntax Std_ReturnType EcuM_ReleasePOST_RUN ( EcuM_UserType user ) Service ID [hex] 0x0b Sync/Async Synchronous Reentrancy Reentrant 5 109 of 210 Document ID 78: AUTOSAR_SWS_ECUStateMan…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_04130",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "The ECU State Manager module shall provide System Services for the following functionalities when the container EcuMModeHandling (see 10.2.1) is available: • requesting RUN • releasing RUN • requesting POST_RUN • relea…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_04131",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "Name EcuM_StateRequest Comment Interface to request a specific ECU state IsService true Variation  0 E_OK Operation successful Possible Errors 1 E_NOT_OK Operation failed Operation ReleasePOSTRUN Comment  Variation …"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_04132",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "The mode port of the ECU State Manager module shall declare the following modes: • STARTUP • RUN • POST_RUN • SLEEP • SHUTDOWN"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_04133",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "Mode changes shall be notified to SW-Cs through the RTE mode ports when the mode change occurs. This specification assumes that the port name is currentMode and that the direct API of RTE will be used. Under these cond…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_04135",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "Name StateRequest_{UserName} Kind ProvidedPort Interface EcuM_StateRequest Description Provides an interface to SW-Cs to request state changes of the ECU state. The port uses port-defined argument values to identify th…"
  },
  {

   "module": "EcuM",

  },
  {

   "text": "Service Name EcuM_LoopDetection Syntax void EcuM_LoopDetection ( void ) Service ID [hex] 0x4B Sync/Async Synchronous Reentrancy Non Reentrant Parameters (in) None Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) None Return va…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_04138",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "EcuM_SetWakeupEvent shall ignore all events passed in the sources parameter that are not associated to the selected sleep mode."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_04139",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "If an OS function call fails and no other fault reaction is defined, the EcuM shall not change the requested state. In such cases an error reporting via EcuM_ErrorHook shall be performed."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_04140",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "EcuM_ValidateWakeupEvent shall invoke ComM_EcuM_ PNCWakeUpIndication for each wakeup event and for every referenced PNC if at least one EcuMComMPNCRef parameter (see ECUC_EcuM_00228) in the EcuMWakeup Source configurat…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_04142",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "The configuration of the ECU Manager module shall specify the order of initialization calls inside the BSW initialization (see EcuMDriverInitListB- swM )."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_04143",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "EcuM shall notify BswM about the current State by calling the in- terface BswM_EcuM_CurrentState(EcuM_StateType State) . A new state shall be set by EcuM when RTE has given its feedback via the acknowledgement port."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_04144",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "When the first RUN or POST_RUN request has been received, ECU State Manager module shall indicate this to BswM using BswM_EcuM_Request- edState(ECUM_STATE_APP_RUN, ECUM_RUNSTATUS_REQUESTED) ."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_04145",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "The EcuM EcuM_AL_DriverInitZero and EcuM_AL_- DriverInitOne functions shall be called by the EcuM_Init function on each core. The implementation of these callout functions shall ensure that only those MCAL mod- ules ar…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_04146",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "If EcuMEcucCoreDefinitionRef is missing then the initial- ization call shall only be performed on the master core."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_EcuM_91001",
   "module": "EcuM",
   "text": "Service Name EcuM_AL_DriverInitBswM_<x> Syntax void EcuM_AL_DriverInitBswM_<x> ( void ) Service ID [hex] 0x28 Sync/Async Synchronous Reentrancy Non Reentrant Parameters (in) None Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out…"
  },

  },
  {

  {

   "module": "WdgM",
   "text": "If the configuration parameter WdgMDevErrorDetect [ ECUC_WdgM_00301 ] i s enabled: The function WdgM_GetLocalStatus shall report the error to default error tracer with error code WDGM_E_UNINIT , without any further eff…"
  },
  {

   "module": "WdgM",
   "text": "Service Name Wdg M_ Get Global Status Syntax Std_ Return Type Wdg M_ Get Global Status ( Wdg M_ Global Status Type* Status ) Service ID [hex] 0x0d Sync/ Async Synchronous Reentrancy Reentrant Parameters (in) None Param…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_WdgM_00182",
   "module": "WdgM",
   "text": "If the current global status is WDGM_GLOBAL_STATUS_OK or WDGM_GLOBAL_STATUS_FAILED then for each Supervised Entity that is activated in the new mode (passed to function WdgM_SetMode as parameter), the function WdgM_Set…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_WdgM_00186",
   "module": "WdgM",
   "text": "If f unction WdgM_SetMode (see [ SWS_WdgM_00154 ]) is called, the Watchdog Manager module shall apply the configured watchdog mode parameters (see WdgMWatchdogMode [ ECUC_WdgM_00332 ]) to each watchdog by calling the W…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_WdgM_00197",
   "module": "WdgM",
   "text": "When the Local Supervision Status of a single Supervised Entity changes, the Watchdog Manager module shall report that change via th e mode port for that Supervised Entity immediately after it has been recognized."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_WdgM_00198",
   "module": "WdgM",
   "text": "When the Global Supervision Status changes, the Watchdog Manager module shall report that change via the global mode port."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_WdgM_00199",
   "module": "WdgM",
   "text": "After computing the Global Supervision Status from all Local Supervision Status , t he Watchdog Manager module shall report any change in the resulting Global Supervision Status only once."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_WdgM_00253",
   "module": "WdgM",
   "text": "If the configuration parameter WdgMDevErrorDetect [ ECUC_WdgM_0 0301 ] is enabled: The function WdgM_GetMode shall report the error to default error tracer with error code WDGM_E_UNINIT , without any further effect, if…"

  {
   "id": "SWS_Wdg_00001",
   "module": "Wdg",
   "text": "The Wdg_Init function shall initialize the Wdg module and the watchdog hardware, i.e. it shall set the default watchdog mode and timeout period as provided i n the configuration set."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_Wdg_00010",
   "module": "Wdg",
   "text": "Type of error Related error code Error value API service used in wrong context (e.g. module not initialized). WDG_ E_ DRIVER_ STATE 0x10 API service called with wrong / inconsistent parameter(s) WDG_ E_ PARAM_ MODE 0x1…"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_Wdg_00016",

   "text": "If switching the Wdg module and the watchdog hardware into the requested mode is not possible, e.g. because of inconsistent mode settings or because some timing constraints have not been met, the Wdg_SetMode function s…"
